description: 10 ground-truth file localization tasks on the 548-file Hono codebase (9 conceptual/behavioral + 1 exact-identifier control)

tasks.query: constant-time string comparison that hashes both inputs and XORs character codes to prevent timing side-channel attacks
tasks.prompt: Locate the primary implementation file (not tests or barrel re-exports) that performs constant-time string comparison by hashing both inputs and XORing character codes to prevent timing attacks.

tasks.query: bounded concurrency task execution pool with an optional cooldown interval before releasing slots
tasks.prompt: Locate the primary implementation file (not tests or barrel re-exports) that implements a bounded concurrency task runner pool with an optional cooldown delay before releasing each active slot.

tasks.query: rejects parent directory traversal segments (..) and appends default index.html when resolving static asset file paths
tasks.prompt: Locate the primary implementation file (not tests or barrel re-exports) that rejects parent-directory traversal segments (`..`) and appends a default `index.html` document when turning a requested path into a static file path.

tasks.query: server-rendered JSX async Suspense boundary catching thrown promises and supporting a CSP script nonce for streamed fallback replacement
tasks.prompt: Locate the primary implementation file (not tests or barrel re-exports) where server-rendered JSX async Suspense boundaries catch thrown Promises and read a CSP script nonce from streaming context.

tasks.query: reads a ReadableStream in fixed 256 KiB chunks and merges byte buffers to incrementally compute a digest hash
tasks.prompt: Locate the primary implementation file (not tests or barrel re-exports) that reads a ReadableStream in fixed 256 KiB chunks, accumulating and merging byte buffers to incrementally compute a digest hash.

tasks.query: detects whether a fetch Response is JSON or text, skips null-body statuses like 204 or 304, and throws a structured error with statusCode and detail when not ok
tasks.prompt: Locate the primary implementation file (not tests or barrel re-exports) that inspects a fetch Response content-type to parse JSON or text, skips body parsing for null-body statuses like 204/304, and throws a structured error with statusCode and detail when the response is not ok.

tasks.query: ranks media types by quality value q and specificity so an explicitly rejected exact media type (q=0) cannot be re-enabled by a subtype wildcard
tasks.prompt: Locate the primary implementation file (not tests or barrel re-exports) that ranks Accept media types by quality value (`q`) and specificity so that an explicitly rejected exact media type (`q=0`) cannot be re-enabled by a subtype wildcard.

tasks.query: logical middleware combinators that short-circuit on the first succeeding handler or abort if any middleware or predicate fails
tasks.prompt: Locate the primary implementation file (not tests or barrel re-exports) that provides logical middleware combinators that short-circuit after the first succeeding handler/predicate or abort when any fails.

tasks.query: checks whether ANSI terminal colors are disabled via NO_COLOR across Node, Deno, and Cloudflare Workers using dynamic cloudflare:workers import
tasks.prompt: Locate the primary implementation file (not tests or barrel re-exports) that checks whether terminal ANSI colors should be disabled across Node, Deno, and Cloudflare Workers via a dynamic `cloudflare:workers` import.

tasks.query: defines ERR_INVALID_IP_ADDRESS and throws TypeError with that error code for malformed IPv4 or IPv6 addresses
tasks.prompt: Locate the primary implementation file (not tests or barrel re-exports) that defines the constant `ERR_INVALID_IP_ADDRESS` and throws a `TypeError` with that error code for malformed IPv4 or IPv6 addresses.
